attributes.action: The DVSA should have a alternative on theory tests for people with disabilities
attributes.additional_details: We're asking the government to bring in a alternative on theory tests for people with learning disability's or special needs to help them get there driving licence
attributes.background: Bring in a alternative for theory test for people with disabilities to help them get a license but they must prove there needs with paper work

rejection.details:
We are not clear what the alternative is that you are suggesting.

We do have this petition open which you may wish to sign:

Review accessibility of driving tests for people with SEN
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771108

This petition might also be of interest to you:

Change the driving test so candidates are not failed for theory questions alone
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778724
